title: Principal divisors in a transcendental simple subfield
statement: Let K and F be fields with a K-algebra structure on F, and let x in F be transcendental over K. For E = IntermediateField.adjoin K {x}, every nonzero g in E has a finitely supported integer-valued divisor D on the project's places of E over K such that D(v) = ord_v(g) for every v and Divisor.degree D = 0. Equivalently, HasPrincipalDivisors K E holds. No characteristic assumption or finiteness assumption on F/E is required.
lean_statement: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Algebra K F] (x : F), Transcendental K x → AlgebraicCurve.HasPrincipalDivisors K (IntermediateField.adjoin K ({x} : Set F))
